children.name: Filicrisia allooeciata Liu, 2001
children.description: Colony erect, flexible, with internodes consisting of a single zooid. Zooid approximately 100 µm wide at the distal end, up to 230 µm at bifurcation. Apertures circular, diameter approximately 90 µm. Pseudopores scattered, slit-like, approximately 1.9 – 2.1 µm wide by 20 – 30 µm long. No gonozooids observed in the studied material.

children.name: Filicrisia geniculata
children.description: "Filicrisia geniculata forms small, straggling, branched colonies which are more or less erect. The internodes normally consist of a single zooid, rarely of 2 to 3. The zooids are long slender cylinders which may be straight, sinuous or slightly angled, with a circular terminal orifice. The zooids produce branches from one or both sides. This bryozoan has no avicularia, vibracula or ovicells"

children.name: Crisia brasiliensis Ramalho & Moraes, 2021
children.description: Colony arborescent, delicate, branched and jointed; new branches usually arising laterally to the fifth or sixth zooid of an internode. Infertile internodes [L 1432 – 1966 – 2613 µm (SD 422, N 8)] composed of 7 – 20 autozooids alternately placed, and 7 – 12 autozooids in fertile internodes; internodes connected by black joints. Autozooids with more or less developed peristome, short to moderately long, usually facing upwards and / or slightly outwards, and with circular aperture; frontal surface with slit-like pseudopores. Large, pear-shaped gonozooid [L 514 – 548 – 578 (SD 24, N 5); W 290 – 309 – 328 µm (SD 16, N 5)], elongate and forming close to a bifurcation; ooeciostome short, curved and facing forward, placed distally of the brood chamber; ooeciopore slightly elliptical [L 50 – 54 – 57 (SD 3, N 4); W 61 – 68 – 76 µm (SD 7; N 4)]; gonozooidal surface punctuated by numerous slit-like pseudopores (internally circular).

children.name: Crisia guang Liu, Liu & Zágoršek, 2019
children.description: Width of internodes approximately 270 – 350 µm, length approximately 1.3 – 3.8 mm; approxi- mately 15 – 20 autozooids per internode. Autozooids approximately 230 µm long (the zooids attached to gonozooid can exceed its length, up to 320 µm), width approximately 80 – 100 µm. Apertures circular, approximately 58 – 68 µm in diameter, with peristome facing frontally. Pseudopores on the frontal wall slit-like (approximately 25 µm long by 2 µm wide), numerous and longitudinally oriented. Gonozooid as long as two to three autozooids, extending across entire branch width. The proximal part of the gonozooid (before dilation) is wider than the equivalent part of an autozooid. Ooeciopore frontally oriented, larger than an autozooidal aperture, oval, wider (ca. 115 µm) than long (ca. 50 µm), distal edge more or less straight, adjacent to the neighbouring autozooidal aperture. Pseudopores more numerous than in autozooids but similar in shape or size.
